name: Turlach Unit 11 EGEO
description: Key Features Large Drying Capacity: Features a spacious 3800-liter drying chamber, allowing for efficient batch processing of large quantities of noodles or similar food products. Optimized Air Temperature: Maintains a consistent air temperature of 29°C, ideal for gentle and uniform drying that preserves product quality and texture. High Moisture Removal Rate: Removes up to 38 kilograms of moisture per day, supporting effective dehydration and reducing overall drying time. Batch Drying System: Designed for 30-hour batch drying cycles, suitable for industrial-scale operations seeking predictable processing times. Cross-Flow Air Circulation: Utilizes a cross-flow airflow pattern to ensure even moisture extraction and consistent drying results across all product layers. Customizable Pricing: Unit price is determined upon acceptance, providing flexibility for different business needs and order volumes. Main Benefits Consistent Product Quality: Precise temperature control and cross-flow air movement help maintain the noodles’ texture, color, and nutritional value, addressing common concerns about over-drying or uneven results. Increased Productivity: Large chamber volume and high moisture removal capacity enable businesses to process more product per cycle, improving operational efficiency. Energy Efficiency: The gentle drying temperature reduces energy consumption compared to higher-heat alternatives, supporting cost savings and sustainability goals. Reliable Performance: 30-hour batch cycles offer predictable processing, making it easier to plan production schedules and meet demand. Typical Use Cases and Outcomes Industrial Noodle Production: Ideal for commercial noodle manufacturers seeking reliable, large-scale drying solutions with consistent output quality. Food Processing Facilities: Suitable for drying a variety of moisture-rich foods where gentle, uniform dehydration is critical. Quality Assurance: Helps businesses meet food safety and quality standards by ensuring thorough and even drying of products. Flexible Operation: Adaptable for different production volumes and requirements, with pricing tailored to specific business needs. Frequently Asked Questions Addressed Is the dryer easy to operate and maintain? Yes, the batch drying system and cross-flow design simplify operation and cleaning for industrial users. Can the dryer accommodate different types of noodles or food products? The spacious chamber and gentle drying temperature make it versatile for various noodle types and similar products. How does this dryer support energy efficiency? By operating at a lower temperature and maximizing moisture removal per cycle, it reduces energy use compared to traditional high-heat dryers. description_html:
Key Features

  • Large Drying Capacity: Features a spacious 3800-liter drying chamber, allowing for efficient batch processing of large quantities of noodles or similar food products.
  • Optimized Air Temperature: Maintains a consistent air temperature of 29°C, ideal for gentle and uniform drying that preserves product quality and texture.
  • High Moisture Removal Rate: Removes up to 38 kilograms of moisture per day, supporting effective dehydration and reducing overall drying time.
  • Batch Drying System: Designed for 30-hour batch drying cycles, suitable for industrial-scale operations seeking predictable processing times.
  • Cross-Flow Air Circulation: Utilizes a cross-flow airflow pattern to ensure even moisture extraction and consistent drying results across all product layers.
  • Customizable Pricing: Unit price is determined upon acceptance, providing flexibility for different business needs and order volumes.

Main Benefits

  • Consistent Product Quality: Precise temperature control and cross-flow air movement help maintain the noodles’ texture, color, and nutritional value, addressing common concerns about over-drying or uneven results.
  • Increased Productivity: Large chamber volume and high moisture removal capacity enable businesses to process more product per cycle, improving operational efficiency.
  • Energy Efficiency: The gentle drying temperature reduces energy consumption compared to higher-heat alternatives, supporting cost savings and sustainability goals.
  • Reliable Performance: 30-hour batch cycles offer predictable processing, making it easier to plan production schedules and meet demand.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Industrial Noodle Production: Ideal for commercial noodle manufacturers seeking reliable, large-scale drying solutions with consistent output quality.
  • Food Processing Facilities: Suitable for drying a variety of moisture-rich foods where gentle, uniform dehydration is critical.
  • Quality Assurance: Helps businesses meet food safety and quality standards by ensuring thorough and even drying of products.
  • Flexible Operation: Adaptable for different production volumes and requirements, with pricing tailored to specific business needs.

Frequently Asked Questions Addressed

  • Is the dryer easy to operate and maintain? Yes, the batch drying system and cross-flow design simplify operation and cleaning for industrial users.
  • Can the dryer accommodate different types of noodles or food products? The spacious chamber and gentle drying temperature make it versatile for various noodle types and similar products.
  • How does this dryer support energy efficiency? By operating at a lower temperature and maximizing moisture removal per cycle, it reduces energy use compared to traditional high-heat dryers.

Relevant Keywords and Synonyms: industrial noodle dryer, large capacity food dehydrator, batch drying chamber, cross-flow air dryer, commercial food processing equipment, gentle dehydration, energy-efficient food dryer, moisture removal system, uniform drying, food safety compliance.
